author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author seeking character artists for 2027 dark fantasy book
content:

Artists, please link your portfolios.

1) NO AI. Real artists only
2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered
3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W)
4) Canadian Artists preferred
5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT

Contact: Reply with portfolio or DM on Threads.

author: Gretchen Ives
title: Romance author seeking cover artist for workplace romance trilogy
content:
Calling all romance book illustrators! I’m looking for a cover artist for my new workplace romance trilogy series. Currently just looking to order one cover but ideally someone I could work with for several. I need someone who has current availability as this is somewhat urgent, a previous illustrator fell through. Absolutely NO AI please! Would love to see your portfolios.

Contact: Reply to post or DM on Threads.

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Seeking artists for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content:
🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀

I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them!

I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters.

Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway!

Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

Contact: DM on Threads with portfolio, pricing, and availability.
